q1.sql:
-- Monthly churn by plan, July and August 2026
select
    plan,
    churn_month,
    active_start,
    churned
from marts.subscription_churn
where churn_month between '2026-07-01' and '2026-08-31'

v1.sql:
-- Churn rate by plan, August 2026
select
    plan,
    churned / active_start as churn_rate
from q1
where churn_month = '2026-08-01'

v2.sql:
-- Churn rate by plan, July 2026
select
    plan,
    churned / active_start as churn_rate
from q1
where churn_month = '2026-07-01'

f1.sql:
select churn_rate
from v1
where plan = 'monthly'
f1.label: Monthly plan churn, August

f2.sql:
select churn_rate
from v1
where plan = 'annual'
f2.label: Annual plan churn, August

i1.text: Monthly subscribers are the churn problem.

i2.text: Every plan churned less in August than it did in July.
